conversation.text:
Packet intentionally refuses hosted Anthropic: Pi's planning sandbox is network-isolated and its only outbound path is a host-side relay restricted (in src/harness/pi_sandbox/provider_bridge/) to OpenAI-compatible APIs on private-HTTP endpoints, with the real credential injected on the host and a placeholder key given to the sandbox. Hosted Anthropic uses the anthropic-messages API over public HTTPS, which fails closed both at protocol ('Planning provider relay currently supports only OpenAI-compatible local providers') and endpoint-scheme/address checks. The supported route to Claude is a local OpenAI-compatible translation proxy on a private address holding your API key.

---
- Need: no decision required to answer this question
- Pointer: consider a future feature to allow an anthropic-messages relay only if you actually want hosted Claude
